cmd: bash -c cd /tmp/lc-build && hipcc -O3 --offload-arch=gfx90a -ffp-contract=off -DUSE_GPU -I. -std=c++17 -o lc lc.cu 2>&1 | tail -5

bash -c 
set -e
cd /tmp/lc-build
echo "=== Gate 1: Lossless round-trip (wave64 ballot paths) ==="
echo "--- RZE_4 ---"
./lc test.dat AL "" "RZE_4"
echo "--- RZE_1 ---"
./lc test.dat AL "" "RZE_1"
echo "--- RLE_4 ---"
./lc test.dat AL "" "RLE_4"
echo "--- BIT_4 RLE_4 ---"
./lc test.dat AL "" "BIT_4 RLE_4"
echo "--- RRE_4 RZE_4 ---"
./lc test.dat AL "" "RRE_4 RZE_4"
echo "--- RAZE_4 ---"
./lc test.dat AL "" "RAZE_4"
echo ""
echo "=== Gate 2: TS self-test ==="
./lc small.dat TS
echo ""
echo "=== Gate 3: Lossy quantizers ==="
echo "--- QUANT_ABS_0_f32 ---"
./lc test.f32 AL "QUANT_ABS_0_f32(0.01)" "BIT_4 RLE_4" "MAXABS_f32(0.01)"
echo "--- QUANT_INOA_0_f64 (thrust path) ---"
./lc test.f64 AL "QUANT_INOA_0_f64(0.01)" "BIT_8 RLE_8" "MAXNOA_f64(0.01)"
echo ""
echo "=== DONE ==="

bash -c 
set -e
echo "=== CROSS-WAVE FORMAT GATE ==="
echo "Creating 1MB test input..."
dd if=/dev/urandom of=/tmp/crosswave_input.dat bs=1024 count=1024 2>/dev/null
# Also create a structured input that exercises the wave64 ballot paths
python3 -c "
import struct
with open(\"/tmp/crosswave_input2.dat\", \"wb\") as f:
    # block with known patterns for zero/repetition elimination
    f.write(bytes(32768))  # zeros - exercises ZE
    f.write(bytes([0xAB]*16384))  # repeats - exercises RE
    import random; random.seed(123)
    f.write(bytes([random.randint(0,255) for _ in range(16384)]))  # random
"
echo "Step 1: GPU compress (wave64/gfx90a) using standalone compressor..."
HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/lc-standalone-gpu/compress /tmp/crosswave_input.dat /tmp/crosswave_compressed.lc 2>&1 | grep -E "compressing|compression ratio|bytes|ERROR" | head -10
echo "GPU compress exit: $?"
echo ""
echo "Step 2: CPU decompress (wave32 path, non-hipified g++ build)..."
/tmp/lc-cpu-decompress/decompress /tmp/crosswave_compressed.lc /tmp/crosswave_decompressed.dat 2>&1 | head -5
echo "CPU decompress exit: $?"
echo ""
echo "Step 3: cmp byte-for-byte..."
cmp /tmp/crosswave_input.dat /tmp/crosswave_decompressed.dat && echo "CROSS-WAVE BYTE-IDENTITY: PASS" || echo "CROSS-WAVE BYTE-IDENTITY: FAIL"
echo ""
echo "Also testing with structured input2..."
HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/lc-standalone-gpu/compress /tmp/crosswave_input2.dat /tmp/crosswave_compressed2.lc 2>&1 | head -3
/tmp/lc-cpu-decompress/decompress /tmp/crosswave_compressed2.lc /tmp/crosswave_decompressed2.dat 2>&1 | head -3
cmp /tmp/crosswave_input2.dat /tmp/crosswave_decompressed2.dat && echo "STRUCTURED INPUT BYTE-IDENTITY: PASS" || echo "STRUCTURED INPUT BYTE-IDENTITY: FAIL"

bash -c 
cd /tmp/lc-cuda-build
/opt/conda/envs/cuda-12.8/bin/nvcc -O3 -arch=sm_80 -fmad=false -DUSE_GPU -I. -std=c++17 \
  -Xcompiler "-O3 -march=native -fopenmp -mno-fma -ffp-contract=off" \
  -x cu -c -o lc_cuda.o lc.cu 2>&1 | grep -E "error:|Error" | head -20
echo "EXIT:$?"
